node.title: DLI Erdos-Turan peak-mass reduction
node.statement: If the normalized odd-evaluation sequence satisfies the required finite-frequency Weyl-sum bounds up to the reciprocal scales used by the DLI peak neighborhoods, then Erdos-Turan plus dyadic annuli around the Dirichlet peaks gives the truncated-log discrepancy and peak-mass tail bounds required by dli_truncated_log_transfer.
node.attack_surface: deterministic interval-discrepancy and dyadic layer-cake reduction
node.falsifier: a sequence satisfying the stated Weyl-sum bounds but violating the required peak-mass or truncated-log discrepancy bound
